items.description: Analyze the repository structure, module purposes, and artifact dataflow before choosing a research route.
items.acceptance_criteria: A written module map covers `README.md`, `TASK_orchestrator.md`, `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`, `.archivara/semantic_scholar.py`, `results/literature/*`, `results/swarm/*`, and the currently missing `results/concept_evolve/*` and `results/verification/*`, and names at least 5 concrete cross-file dependencies.
items.notes: Module map written at results/plans/module_map.md. ConceptEvolve repaired, evolve attempts documented, manual recovery produced 11 concept folders and walk_session.json under results/concept_evolve/.

items.description: Extend `results/literature/literature_snapshot.json` with a targeted Ramsey-specific literature review using web search and the existing Semantic Scholar helper instead of starting from zero.
items.acceptance_criteria: The existing snapshot is preserved and extended with at least 10 Ramsey-relevant papers, at least 2 code repositories or proof-artifact project pages, and at least 2 survey or state-of-the-art sources found via web search; the snapshot explicitly records the current `43 <= R(5,5) <= 46` frontier, the best known lower-bound line, the best known upper-bound line, and the main open bottlenecks.
items.notes: Extended results/literature/literature_snapshot.json with a ramsey_specific_review block: 13 Ramsey-relevant papers, 3 code/proof artifact pages, 2 survey/state-of-the-art sources, the current 43 <= R(5,5) <= 46 frontier, lower/upper-bound lines, and bottleneck notes.

items.description: Read and operationalize the saved swarm synthesis before any implementation so route selection follows local evidence rather than ad hoc choices.
items.acceptance_criteria: The researcher cites `results/swarm/hypotheses.json`, `results/swarm/tool_plan.md`, `results/swarm/director_brief.md`, `results/swarm/gap_map.md`, and `results/swarm/falsifier.md`, keeps `H1` as champion unless a cited blocker appears, and records explicit kill criteria for `H1`, `H2`, and `H3`.
items.notes: Operationalized the saved swarm synthesis in results/plans/ramsey_research_program.md: cites the five swarm anchors, keeps H1 champion, and records explicit kill criteria for H1, H2, and H3.

items.description: Create and maintain `sources.bib` and `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` so novelty claims are anchored to actual prior work rather than lexical query noise.
items.acceptance_criteria: Repo-root `sources.bib` contains BibTeX entries for at least 10 relevant papers plus all consulted code or artifact pages, and `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` includes explicit differentiation notes for the named watchlist papers (`Senolytics Improve Physical Function and Increase Lifespan in Old Age`, `Leveraging polygenic functional enrichment to improve GWAS power`, `Using Simulation and Domain Adaptation to Improve Efficiency of Deep Robotic Grasping`, `The EPR effect and beyond: Strategies to improve tumor targeting and cancer nanomedicine treatment efficacy`) and for the closest Ramsey-specific papers (`Study of Exoo's Lower Bound for Ramsey number R(5,5)`, `Can genetic algorithms with the symmetric heuristic find the Ramsey number R(5,5)`, `A new upper bound on the Ramsey number R(5,5)`, `R(5,5)<=48`, and the `R(5,5)<=46` or Gauthier line).
items.notes: Created sources.bib with 17 paper/code entries and expanded results/literature/prior_art_gap.md with explicit differentiation notes for the watchlist noise and the named Ramsey-specific overlap papers.

items.description: Run a Phase 1 multi-agent literature and novelty cleanup using `explorer`, `novelty_checker`, and `integrator` roles.
items.acceptance_criteria: At least one Codex delegation round separates lexical watchlist noise from true Ramsey prior art, produces a ranked reading list for the next phases, and records at least 3 concrete plan changes caused by the synthesis.
items.notes: Ran one explorer/novelty_checker/integrator delegation round. Recorded the synthesis in results/swarm/phase1_cleanup.md, marked the watchlist as lexical noise only, produced a ranked fixed Ramsey corpus for later phases, and folded five concrete plan changes into results/plans/ramsey_research_program.md.

items.description: Specify the executable baseline stack using existing repo tools and local artifacts before requesting any new code or compute.
items.acceptance_criteria: A baseline matrix maps each planned activity to existing utilities or documents (`.archivara/semantic_scholar.py`, `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`, `results/literature/*`, `results/swarm/*`); any indispensable missing tool is logged as a blocker rather than implemented ad hoc.
items.notes: Created results/plans/phase2_baseline_sheet.md with an executable baseline matrix covering repo utilities and saved artifacts, plus a blocker list for the missing frontier corpus, extension enumerator, witness verifier, and certificate checker.

items.description: Define the lower-bound baseline metrics and witness standards that distinguish real progress from proxy optimization.
items.acceptance_criteria: The baseline spec requires independent verification for any `44`-vertex claim and tracks at least 5 lower-bound metrics, including witness recovery from neutral starts, family diversity beyond Exoo-like seeds, witness-safety under filters, equalized search effort, and failure-mode logging.
items.notes: Expanded results/plans/phase2_baseline_sheet.md with lower-bound acceptance criteria: independent verification for any 44-vertex claim, six tracked metrics, and witness standards for provenance, seed neutrality, and external revalidation.

items.description: Define the upper-bound baseline metrics and certificate standards before any new decomposition or solver narrative is explored.
items.acceptance_criteria: The baseline spec tracks at least 5 upper-bound metrics, including residue size, proof bytes, checker runtime, exactness or rationalization status, and matched-baseline runtime, and states that only a machine-checkable `45`-vertex impossibility proof or residue with a clear certificate path counts as upper-bound progress.
items.notes: Expanded results/plans/phase2_baseline_sheet.md with six upper-bound metrics, explicit certificate standards, and the rule that only a machine-checkable 45-vertex impossibility proof or a residue with a clear certificate path counts as upper-bound progress.

items.description: Force modular concept exploration by planning the first `results/concept_evolve/tree/` pass with the existing ConceptEvolve helper.
items.acceptance_criteria: The baseline plan specifies `.archivara/concept_evolve.py evolve` and `walk` as the first concept exploration step after Phase 1, expects at least 10 concept folders under `results/concept_evolve/tree/`, and requires each folder to carry a concrete experiment seed, closest prior art, and a mapping to `H1`, `H2`, or `H3`.
items.notes: Expanded results/plans/phase2_baseline_sheet.md with the ConceptEvolve first-pass contract: the required evolve and walk commands, confirmation of 11 concept folders, route coverage from results/concept_evolve/tree/index.json, and the no-drift rule before further promotion.

items.description: Run a Phase 2 multi-agent baseline audit using `worker`, `benchmark_auditor`, and `integrator` roles.
items.acceptance_criteria: At least one Codex delegation round reviews whether lower-bound and upper-bound baselines are equalized, whether certificate requirements are explicit, and whether no-cheat rules are clear; the resulting audit lists at least 5 concrete baseline integrity rules.
items.notes: Ran one worker/benchmark_auditor/integrator delegation round. Consolidated the findings in results/verification/benchmark_report.md, tightened the baseline with an explicit matched-compute protocol and upper-bound win rule, and recorded 10 concrete baseline integrity rules.

items.description: Specify the champion `H1` route as a reusable obstruction-atlas program rather than a generic improved search engine.
items.acceptance_criteria: The plan defines the canonical data model for known `42`-vertex frontier colorings, orbit-distinct `42 -> 43` extensions, failure witnesses, and minimal obstruction cores, with explicit input artifacts, output artifacts, and falsifiable recurrence and transfer claims.
items.notes: Created results/plans/phase3_route_sheet.md to define H1 as a cross-family canonical obstruction atlas, including the frontier_parent/extension_case/failure_witness/core/transfer data model, explicit input and output artifacts, and falsifiable recurrence and transfer claims.

items.description: Predefine `H1` transfer, soundness, and stop rules before any experiment is run.
items.acceptance_criteria: The `H1` plan includes leave-one-parent-out transfer tests, witness-survival audits on all known `42` and `43` constructions, a kill condition if recurring cores do not generalize across parent families, and a pivot rule that unlocks `H2` only after those checks fail.
items.notes: Expanded results/plans/phase3_route_sheet.md with explicit H1 transfer and soundness gates, pass criteria, kill conditions, and the pivot rule that opens H2 only after those checks fail.

items.description: Use concept-tree probing to widen and narrow the champion idea without uncontrolled method drift.
items.acceptance_criteria: The plan requires `.archivara/concept_evolve.py probe`, `reframe`, and `iterate` on the selected `H1` bottleneck, and expects at least 3 promoted folders inside `results/concept_evolve/tree/` with updated `README.md` and `literature.json` entries tied to executable tests.
items.notes: Attempted the mandatory probe run, recovered results manually after a helper stall, wrote results/concept_evolve/probe_result.json, recorded the probe delta, added the future reframe/iterate requirements to results/plans/phase3_route_sheet.md, and promoted four H1 folders with executable-test README and literature updates.

items.description: Define bounded backup and attachment routes for `H2` and `H3` that do not dilute the champion program.
items.acceptance_criteria: The plan lists 2 to 3 concrete `H2` decomposition primitives and 1 `H3` certificate-carrying attachment, each with matched-baseline success criteria, explicit non-claims, and a statement that no standalone `H3` track proceeds before `H1` or `H2` yields a transferable structural object.
items.notes: Expanded results/plans/phase3_route_sheet.md with three bounded H2 decomposition primitives, one H3 certificate-carrying attachment, matched-baseline success criteria, explicit non-claims, and route-discipline rules that keep H3 attachment-only.

items.description: Run a Phase 3 multi-agent hypothesis stress test using `research_director`, `falsifier`, `novelty_checker`, and `integrator` roles.
items.acceptance_criteria: At least one Codex delegation round challenges `H1`, `H2`, and `H3`, and the synthesis explicitly keeps, kills, or demotes each route using documented thresholds rather than preference statements.
items.notes: Ran one research_director/falsifier/novelty_checker/integrator delegation round. Recorded the synthesis in results/swarm/phase3_stress_test.md: H1 kept under probationary thresholds, H2 demoted to inactive backup, H3 demoted to attachment-only infrastructure, and no route killed because no written kill condition has fired yet.

items.description: Design the first exact experiment ladder around the smallest decisive tests instead of broad exploratory compute.
items.acceptance_criteria: The experiment plan starts with the fastest invalidators from `results/swarm/falsifier.md`, schedules one atlas pass, one held-out transfer pass, and one witness-safety pass for `H1` before any expansion, and defines the exact artifact expected at each rung.
items.notes: Created results/plans/phase4_evaluation_sheet.md with the Phase 4 entry reframe, the fastest invalidators, and an exact Rung 0-3 ladder naming the atlas, held-out transfer, and witness-safety artifacts before any expansion.

items.description: Predefine comparisons against named prior work from the literature review instead of weak or stale baselines.
items.acceptance_criteria: Every planned evaluation table compares against named prior work from Phase 1, including Exoo's lower-bound line, `Study of Exoo's Lower Bound for Ramsey number R(5,5)`, `Can genetic algorithms with the symmetric heuristic find the Ramsey number R(5,5)`, `A new upper bound on the Ramsey number R(5,5)`, `R(5,5)<=48`, and the `R(5,5)<=46` or Gauthier line, and includes a column stating whether the proposed result improves a bound, improves a certificate path, or improves neither.
items.notes: Expanded results/plans/phase4_evaluation_sheet.md with a fixed prior-work matrix covering the named lower- and upper-bound baselines, a shared-comparison-object column, and the required result-type column for bound vs certificate-path improvements.

items.description: Create specialist verification artifacts under `results/verification/` before treating any result as publishable or even internally solid.
items.acceptance_criteria: The plan requires `results/verification/novelty_report.md`, `results/verification/citation_audit.md`, `results/verification/benchmark_report.md`, and `results/verification/verification_summary.md`, with `novelty_checker`, `citation_auditor`, and `benchmark_auditor` each owning one artifact and all four cross-referencing the active hypothesis and the bound-moving threshold.
items.notes: Created the full verification packet under results/verification/: novelty_report.md from novelty_checker, citation_audit.md from citation_auditor, benchmark_report.md from benchmark_auditor, and a parent verification_summary.md. All four cross-reference active hypothesis H1 and the bound-moving threshold.

items.description: Define compute governance, fail-fast pivots, and anti-proxy rules before any expensive run is authorized.
items.acceptance_criteria: The plan states explicit stop conditions for proxy-only gains, unsound pruning, non-transfer, missing certificate paths, stale baselines, and overfit seed families, and maps each stop condition to a documented pivot, rollback, or shutdown action.
items.notes: Expanded results/plans/phase4_evaluation_sheet.md with a compute-governance pivot map covering proxy-only gains, unsound pruning, non-transfer, missing certificate paths, stale baselines, overfit seed families, replay failure, and the authorization rule for expensive runs.

items.description: Run a Phase 4 multi-agent evaluation rehearsal using `monitor`, `benchmark_auditor`, `citation_auditor`, and `integrator` roles.
items.acceptance_criteria: At least one Codex delegation round rehearses the evaluation flow, verifies that required artifacts can be checked in order, and surfaces at least 3 sequencing risks before any compute-heavy execution begins.
items.notes: Ran one monitor/benchmark_auditor/citation_auditor/integrator delegation round and recorded the rehearsal at results/verification/evaluation_rehearsal.md. The synthesis fixes the precompute check order and surfaces seven sequencing risks before any compute-heavy execution begins.

items.description: Define the final claim grammar so the project reports bound improvements, structural intermediate results, and negative results honestly.
items.acceptance_criteria: The documentation plan distinguishes bound improvements, structural intermediate results, negative results, and infrastructure-only outputs, and includes explicit forbidden phrasings for proxy metrics being presented as progress.
items.notes: Materialized a dedicated reporting policy at results/plans/claim_grammar.md. It distinguishes bound, structural, negative, and infrastructure-only claim classes, sets the current no-go ceiling, and lists explicit forbidden phrasings for proxy metrics.

items.description: Keep the persistent context files current throughout the run, especially the prior-art differentiation log.
items.acceptance_criteria: `results/research_context.md` and `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` are updated at each major route change with dates, chosen hypothesis, active blockers, and differentiation notes against the closest prior art.
items.notes: Refreshed results/research_context.md to the current Phase 5 state and added a dated major-route-change log to results/literature/prior_art_gap.md. Both files now record the chosen hypothesis, active blockers, and differentiation against Ge 2022, Lehavi 2024, and the upper-bound lines.

items.description: Finalize citation completeness and reproducibility packaging before any writer draft is accepted.
items.acceptance_criteria: `sources.bib` cites every paper, code repository, and verification source used in the final report; every structural or experimental claim points to a local artifact or bibliography entry; and any remaining citation gap is recorded explicitly.
items.notes: Repaired sources.bib with primary arXiv and DOI metadata for the load-bearing Ge 2022, Lehavi 2024, and Gauthier-Brown 2024 rows, split the proceedings and preprint records, and added results/verification/claim_source_map.md to anchor every active structural or experimental claim to local artifacts and bibliography entries with explicit remaining gaps.

items.description: Prepare a reviewer packet centered on artifact paths, decision history, and branch outcomes rather than narrative gloss.
items.acceptance_criteria: The final package includes a concise artifact index covering literature outputs, concept-tree outputs, experiment specs, verification reports, and route pivots, plus a chronological decision log explaining why each branch was promoted, killed, or kept in reserve.
items.notes: Built the reviewer packet at results/artifact_index.md and results/decision_log.md. The index covers literature, concept-tree, experiment, verification, and route-pivot artifacts, and the log records the dated promotion, demotion, and reserve decisions for H1, H2, and H3.

items.description: Run a Phase 5 multi-agent final review using `reviewer`, `citation_auditor`, `novelty_checker`, and `integrator` roles.
items.acceptance_criteria: At least one Codex delegation round performs a findings-first review of the full artifact set, and no final research memo is accepted until the review records zero unresolved critical issues.
items.notes: Ran one final review round with a reviewer-style default agent plus citation_auditor, novelty_checker, and integrator roles, then resolved the packet-consistency findings by adding results/verification/h1_acceptance_contract.md, updating the citation and memo-scope summaries, aligning the iterate artifacts, and writing results/verification/final_review.md with zero unresolved critical issues for the constrained no-go memo.
